item: R783: the restore opens each file folder by folder, never following a link (POSIX)
summary: Where the system offers handle-relative open, stat and listing, O_NOFOLLOW and O_DIRECTORY (a capability check, never the OS name), a folder restore walks the backup by folder handle (its own walk: os.fwalk raised where os.walk passes over, so one unopenable, unlistable or very deep folder stopped the whole restore) and opens every member one name at a time from the category folder with O_NOFOLLOW, the category folder checked to be the one walked; a folder swapped for a link after the checks is refused by the open itself with R779's counts; at most three handles at any depth. Elsewhere R779's path and stated limit stay. Help x12: the POSIX half of the limit is dropped, the Windows half stays.
